pages.text: Rare and heavily armoured, and it flees from you. Catch it: a wild one drops the $(l:bosses/arenas)Desert Sigil$(/l) that opens the Dozen-legged Wrath's arena.$(br2)Tamed and bred ones drop nothing. A $(l:pets/pets)pet parent$(/l), paired with the Shieldback.
pages.title: Gold-Encrusted Scarab
